jobs.title: Medior .NET Backend Developer
jobs.description:
### **About the Company**

  

S4D is a Software as Service (SaaS) company that provides Quick Service Restaurants (QSRs) with the omnichannel operating system to run their business in the most effective and efficient way. In other words, we help restaurants to get more orders. Our team builds and services innovative products based on the newest technologies, consisting of a wide variety of functionalities and innovative modules while offering our employees flexible working conditions. Our key values are teamwork and ownership. S4D is part of the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 and Saas100 company (selected by MT/Sprout).

### **About the Role**


We are looking for a Medior .NET Backend Developer who combines solid software engineering practices with a passion for building reliable cloud systems. In this role, you will take ownership of core backend features \- contributing to solution design, writing high\-quality C\# code, and deploying resilient microservices across our cloud platforms.


You will collaborate closely with senior engineers and team members to maintain high technical standards, participate in peer code reviews, and continuously improve our codebase.


We also encourage our engineers to utilize modern AI developer tools (such as Cursor or Claude Code) to accelerate daily workflows and streamline problem\-solving.

**Notice to Recruiters \& Agencies:** We handle all hiring in\-house and do not accept unsolicited agency outreach, candidate submissions, or services. Please do not contact us.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Feature Ownership:** Take ownership of backend services across feature lifecycles\- from technical implementation and testing to deployment and operational monitoring.
* **Service Development:** Write clean, modular, and maintainable C\# code targeting modern .NET Core runtimes, adhering to established architectural patterns.
* **Asynchronous Messaging:** Build and maintain reliable integrations and event\-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus and MassTransit.
* **Quality \& Testing:** Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, actively participate in continuous integration workflows, and optimize application performance.
* **Collaborative Engineering:** Participate in constructive code reviews, share technical knowledge with peers, and contribute to technical design discussions alongside senior team members.
* **AI\-Assisted Workflows:** Leverage modern AI coding tools to boost productivity, write test cases, and troubleshoot complex bugs effectively.

### **What You Bring (Mandatory)**

* **3\+ years** of hands\-on backend software engineering experience with **C\# and .NET Core**.
* **Solid Feature Delivery:** Proven experience building and shipping RESTful APIs or microservices to production environments.
* **Messaging \& Event\-Driven Patterns:** Practical experience with message queues or event brokers (e.g., Azure Service Bus, MassTransit, RabbitMQ, or Kafka).
* **Azure Cloud Experience:** Practical familiarity with core Microsoft Azure services and cloud\-native concepts.
* **Testing \& Quality Mindset:** Experience with automated unit testing (e.g., xUnit, NUnit) and a strong commitment to clean code principles (SOLID, DRY).
* **Collaborative Mindset:** Strong communication skills and a desire to contribute in an open, feedback\-driven engineering environment.
* **Location \& Work Authorization:** Must be currently residing in the Netherlands and hold a valid, unrestricted working permit.

### **Nice\-to\-Haves**

* Direct experience with **Event driven patterns** in production.
* Familiarity with containerization (**Docker, Kubernetes**).
* Hands\-on experience writing relational database queries and working with **SQL Server / Entity Framework Core**.
* Experience working with modern CI/CD pipelines (**Azure DevOps** or **GitHub Actions**).
* Exposure to legacy system migration projects (.NET Framework to modern .NET).
* Experience incorporating developer AI tooling (e.g., **Cursor**, **Claude Code**) into your daily development routine.

jobs.description:
### **Dein Code geht in Produktion – bis an die Maschine**


Werde Teil der Unternehmensgruppe ppg \> und gestalte mit uns die Welt der Verpackungen aktiv mit. Du liebst es, dort zu arbeiten, wo IT und Produktion aufeinandertreffen, und willst unser eigenes ERP\-System mit modernsten Tools wie Claude Code aufs nächste Level heben? Wir suchen jemanden, der mitdenkt und Lösungen direkt mit den Menschen baut, die täglich damit arbeiten.

**Komm ins Team – und bau mit uns an der digitalen Zukunft der Gruppe!**

#### **Deine Benefits**

* 1\.000€ Einstiegsprämie
* faire Bezahlung auf Verhandlungsbasis \+ BAV \+ VWL
* 6 Wochen Urlaub
* Fahrrad/ E\-Bike\-Leasing
* Firmenfitness

#### **AUFGABEN**

**DEINE MISSION – SOFTWAREENTWICKLUNG**

* **Weiterentwicklung:** Du baust unser eigenes ERP\-System "fs\+" weiter aus – mit C\#, WPF und MS SQL Server, von der Datenbankstruktur bis zur fertigen Oberfläche.
* **Anforderungsmanagement:** Du klärst Anforderungen direkt mit den jeweiligen Fachbereichen und entwickelst passgenaue Lösungen.
* **Migration \& Deployment:** Du überführst unsere gewachsene Alt\-Anwendung Modul für Modul nach fs\+, testest deinen Code und begleitest diesen über Pull Request und CI/CD bis ins produktive Update.
* **Support \& Bugfixing:** Du analysierst und behebst Fehler im laufenden Betrieb an mehreren Standorten – auch dann, wenn die Ursache tief in der Alt\-Anwendung liegt. Zudem weist du Anwender in Neuerungen ein und unterstützt tatkräftig bei alltäglichen Problemen.
* **KI\-Gestützte Entwicklung:** Du nutzt die KI Claude Code aktiv in deinem Entwickleralltag und gibst deine Erfahrungen dazu an das Team weiter.

 **Profil**

* **Qualifikation:** Du hast eine Ausbildung zum/zur Fachinformatiker/\-in für Anwendungsentwicklung, ein Informatikstudium oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit.
* **Tech\-Stack:** Du bringst Kenntnisse in C\#, WPF, MS SQL Server, Git und dem Pull\-Request\-basierten Arbeiten mit.
* **Mindset:** Du hast eine selbstständige Arbeitsweise, auf deine Zusagen ist Verlass und du bringst große Freude am direkten Draht zu den Anwendern mit.
* **Nice\-to\-have:** Berufserfahrung, Know\-how in KI\-gestützter Entwicklung (Claude Code), Bitbucket, CI/CD oder VB.NET\-Lesekenntnisse (für unsere Alt\-Anwendung) sind wünschenswert.
* **Perspektive:** Du musst nicht alles am ersten Tag können. Unser ERP ist über Jahre gewachsen – das lernt niemand über Nacht. Wir zeigen dir alles in Ruhe Modul für Modul, du bekommst die Zeit dafür und wächst schrittweise in deine Aufgabe hinein!

jobs.title: Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control
jobs.description:
**The Robotics \& Mechatronics Teams at Agile Robots** are looking for a **Software Engineer (m/f/d) Industrial Robot Control**, who will develop C\+\+ control software for the robot arm, from single\-motor to multi\-body control.


### **Responsibilities**


* **Control Software:** Design and develop C\+\+ software for the robot's control stack, covering kinematics, trajectory generation, and compliance control from single\-motor to multi\-body coordination.
* **Hardware Tuning:** Support parameter identification and controller\-gain tuning against physical hardware, working alongside more senior engineers to close the gap between simulation and real behavior.
* **Real\-Time Performance:** Profile control software and help keep it within the timing margins the arm's safety and stability depend on.
* **Hardware Validation:** Write automated software tests, define hardware testing procedures, and work hands\-on with the robot to confirm control software behaves correctly outside simulation.
* **Code Quality:** Take part in code reviews with the wider team, both giving and receiving feedback that keeps the control codebase maintainable.
* **Technology Evaluation:** Investigate and evaluate emerging robotic control methods and algorithms relevant to the team's work.

### **Essential Skills**


* **Background:** Degree in computer science, control engineering, mechatronics, or a related engineering field, with one to three years of professional experience in C\+\+ development, or an equivalent record of relevant academic or project work.
* **Kinematics \& Dynamics:** Working understanding of robot kinematics and dynamics, sufficient to reason about forward and inverse mappings and trajectory generation for a multi\-body arm.
* **Control Engineering:** Background in control engineering, with some exposure to parameter identification and controller tuning.
* **Modern C\+\+:** Working proficiency in modern C\+\+, including thread\-safe and exception\-safe code, and comfort working across the standard build, test, and debugging toolchain on Linux.
* **Hardware Troubleshooting:** Basic ability and willingness to troubleshoot and debug directly on physical robotic hardware, not only software running in isolation.

### **Beneficial Skills**


* **Python:** Working programming skills in Python or a similar scripting language, used alongside C\+\+ for tooling and analysis.
* **CI/CD Ownership:** Experience maintaining or extending CI/CD pipelines for a C\+\+ codebase.

### **What we offer**


* A dynamic high\-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world\-class investors.
* Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60\+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
* Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
* Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
* Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
* Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks \& fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

### **About us**



**Agile Robots SE** is an international high\-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than **3500** employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state\-of\-the\-art force\-moment\-sensing and world\-leading image\-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user\-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly.



This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us!



We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

jobs.title: Senior Broadcast Engineer
jobs.description:
**Want to accelerate your career? Electrify your potential as a Senior Broadcast Engineer and join the fastest growing motorsport on the planet!**

***About Formula E:***


Formula E, the world's fastest\-growing sport, is redefining motorsport with a bold focus on innovation and sustainability.


Hosting over 150 races in iconic cities globally and backed by top manufacturers like Porsche, Nissan and Jaguar, we feature elite drivers and cutting\-edge EV technology.
  

  

As the world's first certified B Corp sport and the first sport certified to the British Standards Institution (BSI) Net Zero Pathway. Formula E combines thrilling entertainment with a mission to advance sustainable progress, inspiring a global fanbase with our high\-performance brand new GEN4 car capable of hitting speeds of 335kph and reaching 200kph in just 4\.4 seconds. Currently achieving 0\-100 kmh in 1\.8 seconds.


Using the spectacle of sport, we are sending a powerful and meaningful message to help alter perceptions and speed\-up the switch to electric mobility.

***The Role:***


As the Senior Broadcast Engineer, you will lead the technical and operational delivery of Formula E's brand\-new Multi\-Language Production ecosystem for Season 13\. Reporting to the Broadcast \& Media Technology Director, this role acts as the core technical anchor trackside on\-site during race weeks to maintain exceptional production quality across 7 new language feeds, while driving next\-generation technology projects during the off\-season.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **On\-Site Trackside Operations:** Serve as the central technical and operational anchor for Multi\-Language Production teams on\-site during race weeks. Manage, allocate, and troubleshoot all trackside technical resources required by production partners, while providing engineering support to the primary Host Broadcast team.
* **Operational Rotation \& Resilience:** Maintain workflow redundancy and team resilience by swapping physical locations with the Broadcast Technical Manager every third race to manage central remote production facility operations.
* **Off\-Season Planning \& Innovation:** Oversee advanced engineering and technical pre\-planning of on\-site requirements for future race calendar locations. Take the technical lead on scoping, developing, and deploying advanced initiatives like HDR workflows, enhanced audio, and automated Team Radio transcription tools.
* **Internal Test Programmes:** Lead the technology deployment for the Formula E Test Programme, managing the deployed tech team in rotation with the Broadcast Technical Manager.
* **Mentorship \& Alignment:** Work in close tandem with the Broadcast Technical Manager to align trackside engineering with central production operations, while providing professional mentorship and technical training to junior members of the Technology team.

***What we're looking for in you:***

* **Experience**: At least 10 years of experience in Live Broadcast Engineering. Demonstrable track record delivering high\-profile global host broadcasts, unilateral operations at major global events, and complex multi\-language, multi\-feed live productions.
* **Technical Mastery:** Deep expertise in live broadcast infrastructure, REMI/centralized workflows, and trackside engineering setup. Exceptional real\-time troubleshooting skills to maintain workflow redundancy in live, high\-stress environments.
* **Project Leadership:** Proven capability in managing off\-season technology initiatives, scoping complex venue requirements, and integrating advanced tools (HDR, immersive audio, AI transcription).
* **Mindset \& Personal Qualities:** Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable thriving in high\-velocity, live sports settings. Quality\-obsessed with an uncompromising commitment to flawless execution, a collaborative team player, and a proactive mentor who pushes technical boundaries.

***What's in it for you?***

* 25 days' annual leave, Birthday day off and Wellbeing leave
* Opportunity to extend your stay if travelling for a race event
* Health Cash Plan and access to the Aviva Digital Workplace app
* Enhanced Parental Leave
* Flexible Bank Holidays
* Paid volunteer and carer's leave
* Cycle to Work and Electric Car Scheme
* Formula E store discount
* Regular social events and employee working groups

*This is a hybrid role and you'll be required to do 3 days a week in our Hammersmith London office*

***Application Process***


Think you’ve got what it takes to join our race to the future?


The closing date for this role is **14th October 2026**, however if we receive a high volume of applications we may close it early.


At Formula E, we are building a culture where every voice matters, every perspective accelerates progress, and every individual is empowered to rise, contribute boldly, and shape a better world \- together. We will provide equal opportunities regardless of an individuals' protected characteristics. We believe in attracting and retaining diverse talent to strengthen our global vision with a variety of experiences, backgrounds and perspectives.

**Our mission is clear. The message is simple. Whoever you are. However you live. Whatever you believe. Formula E. For the Future. For Everyone.**

**We’ll see you at the starting line!**

***¡VAMOS!***


If you require further assistance in accessing the application or require a different format of the application, please contact recruitment@fiaformulae.com


If this role isn’t quite for you but you want to join Formula E, why not ‘Connect’ with us here to be the first to know of new opportunities!

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack App Developer
jobs.description:
**Joining Team Norse is more than getting a job. It is all about belonging.**


Always dreamt of doing things differently? Join us in Comtech at Norse Atlantic Airways, where we build the digital products behind a challenger airline.


We think differently and we act differently. We are not afraid to challenge conventional wisdom and test new ideas. We are a data\-driven, product\-first organization powered by a small, tight\-knit team of developers, product managers and data scientists — plus a few potatoes.


If these prospects inspire you, then we want to talk to you!


Potatoes: a Norwegian term for people who can do a little bit of everything.

 **Why This Role is Exciting**


Our Flutter app is at the heart of Norse's digital experience, and we're looking for someone to take real ownership of it. You'll be the driving force behind the mobile app while working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with a small engineering team — which means your day won't stop at the app. In a lean team, the best people wear more than one hat, so you'll also jump in to support the wider stack: our GraphQL layer, our .NET / C\# backend services, and the integrations that hold it all together. Your heart is in app development, but your reach goes across the whole product.


This role sits within Comtech and reports to the Head of Ecom and Product.  

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**

  

Flutter App Development (your main focus)

* Own the design, development and maintenance of our cross\-platform mobile app in Flutter and Dart, delivering a high\-performing, scalable and user\-friendly experience on both iOS and Android.
* Drive the app's architecture and set best practices for state management, testing and release, keeping the codebase clean and maintainable.
* Partner with UX/UI designers to build intuitive, engaging interfaces, and iterate based on user testing and experimentation.
* Optimize app performance — load times, responsiveness and stability — across a wide range of devices.


Backend \& Fullstack Support

* Roll up your sleeves alongside the rest of the team to support our general stack, contributing to backend services built with .NET Core and C\#.
* Design, consume and extend GraphQL APIs that connect the app and web front\-ends to our backend systems.
* Help design robust, secure and reliable integrations, ensuring smooth communication between the app, the backend and third\-party services.
* Support and unblock fellow engineers across the stack — reviewing code, pairing and stepping in wherever the team needs an extra pair of hands.


Architecture \& Collaboration

* Take ownership of end\-to\-end delivery, from architecture through to deployment, following clean architecture principles.
* Work within Agile Scrum, participating in sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives with product managers, designers and fellow engineers.
* Collaborate closely with a cross\-functional team to ship a best\-in\-class product, fast.


Code Review, Mentorship \& Innovation

* Conduct thorough code reviews and champion high coding standards across the app and the wider stack.
* Mentor and support other developers, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
* Stay ahead of emerging technologies and industry trends, proposing and implementing ideas that push our products forward.

**What You Bring to the Table**

* 5\+ years of software development experience, with a strong focus on mobile development in Flutter and Dart.
* Proven experience shipping and maintaining production mobile apps on iOS and Android.
* Solid backend experience with .NET Core and C\#, and comfort working across a fullstack codebase.
* Hands\-on experience with GraphQL (designing, consuming or extending APIs).
* Experience with RESTful APIs and integrating third\-party services.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably Azure.
* A passion for clean, maintainable and scalable code, and strong problem\-solving and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile teams, and a startup mindset that thrives in a small, high\-ownership team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (desired but not required).

**AI\-Assisted Development**

* Proficient with AI\-assisted and agentic software development tools such as Claude Code — or able to become proficient very quickly — using them effectively for coding, codebase exploration, refactoring, debugging, testing, code review and engineering automation.
* Comfortable designing workflows where AI agents can safely perform or accelerate repetitive engineering tasks, while applying appropriate review and engineering judgment.
* Actively explores new AI\-assisted development practices and helps establish effective patterns for using them across the team.

**Why Join Comtech?**

**Take real ownership of a product used by travelers around the world.**

* Work in an innovative, fast\-paced environment where your work truly matters.
* Get access to leading AI development tools, with their use encouraged as part of the normal development workflow — we're building a modern, highly productive small engineering team.
* Flexible work arrangements at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.
* Enjoy the same great staff travel benefits as employees across Norse Atlantic Airways.
* Join a dynamic and international team building the future of airline travel.

**This position is located at our HQ in Arendal, Norway, or our office in Riga, Latvia.**

**Here's a taste of what life in Arendal and Southern Norway has to offer:**

**www.visitsorlandet.com**

**www.gotoarendal.com**

**www.welcomehub.no**

**www.businessregionkristiansand.no**

**If you're ready to take ownership of our app and help build something that matters in the airline industry, we'd love to hear from you!**  



**We believe that culture will be our competitive advantage.**


Team Norse has identified three core values that we all should live and breathe.  

They are:


* Be inclusive
* Take ownership
* Show kindness.

**Deadline to apply : 15 October.**

  

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to send an email to: careers@flynorse.com


Please note: you have 2 days from submission to edit your cover letter before it can no longer be changed.

jobs.title: Engineering Support Specialist I (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Are you a technically minded student or a professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and making sure things are configured correctly?


You'll support our **Cabin Management System** team as an **Application Engineer** by processing aircraft configuration requests, working with technical documentation, and communicating with suppliers to ensure customer requirements are implemented accurately.


We're looking for someone with a technical mindset who likes working with data, pays attention to detail, and enjoys solving day\-to\-day challenges. You don't need to be a programmer, but you should be comfortable working with technical information and learning new tools and processes.


This is a **part\-time role for 20 hours per week** . It could be a great fit if you're a student in a technical field looking for hands\-on experience, or a parent returning from maternity or parental leave who wants a flexible role as an **Application Engineer.**

*Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.*

*As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com*  

*Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.*

***Please note that due to export restrictions, we will only be able to take into consideration applicants with an EU or US citizenship.***

jobs.title: Développeur .NET/SQL h/f
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un Développeur .NET/SQL expérimenté pour l’un de nos clients **basé au nord de Luxembourg** !


Au sein d'une équipe de développement à taille humaine, vous participez à l'évolution et à la maintenance d'un système MES (Manufacturing Execution System) stratégique, utilisé pour piloter l'ensemble des processus de production industrielle. Vous intervenez sur des applications critiques fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7\.


Vos responsabilités :

* Analyser les besoins des utilisateurs et proposer des solutions adaptées aux enjeux métiers.
* Concevoir, développer et maintenir des applications .NET destinées au suivi et au pilotage des activités industrielles.
* Participer à l'amélioration continue du système MES afin de couvrir l'ensemble des processus de production.
* Collaborer avec les équipes métier pour optimiser les flux de travail, le monitoring et l'analyse des données de production.
* Développer de nouvelles fonctionnalités favorisant la communication et la collaboration entre les différents services.
* Concevoir et maintenir des API, web services et microservices.
* Optimiser les performances applicatives et les requêtes SQL.
* Concevoir, développer et maintenir des procédures stockées SQL Server complexes.
* Participer aux phases de tests, validation et déploiement des solutions.
* Contribuer aux démarches Agile et aux bonnes pratiques de développement.

  

Profil :

* Forte capacité d'analyse et de compréhension des processus métiers.
* Excellente maîtrise du développement en C\#.
* Solide expérience sur .NET Framework 4\.8 et .NET Core / .NET 9\.
* Bonne connaissance du développement d'interfaces avec Blazor Hybrid MAUI.
* Expérience dans la conception et l'intégration de :
	+ APIs REST
	+ Microservices
	+ gRPC
	+ Web Services
* Maîtrise des formats d'échange XML et JSON.
* Expertise en SQL Server Enterprise (2017 à 2025\).
* Très bonne maîtrise du T\-SQL, des procédures stockées et de l'optimisation des performances SQL.
* Utilisation quotidienne de Visual Studio 2022\-2026\.
* Connaissance des composants ComponentOne/ Mescius.
* Pratique des outils de gestion Agile et de suivi de projet tels que Jira.
* Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais

jobs.title: Software Test Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

Coherent Corp is the global leader in photonics, designing and manufacturing advanced laser, optical, and materials technologies. Our innovations power semiconductor manufacturing, AI infrastructure, advanced communications, and precision industrial systems worldwide. With a global footprint and cutting-edge manufacturing and R&D, we’re shaping the future of high-tech industries.

Software Test Development Engineer

This is a hands-on software engineering role within an R&D environment, focused on building, maintaining and adapting the software infrastructure required to communicate with and control instrumentation for optical component testing. Your work will support early-stage R&D testing and the development of reliable, automated test solutions for use throughout component development and manufacturing. In the role, you will work closely with on-site teams across Chip Design, Wafer Fabrication, Process Engineering, Operations, Quality & Reliability, Verification, and Project Management.

What you will be doing...

Contribute to the design and planning of new test setups, with a focus on software for component control, characterisation, and verification.
Develop and maintain software used to control instruments and devices, collect measurements, and process test data.
Support the development and validation of algorithms that automate component control and characterisation activities
Help ensure test processes are robust, reliable, and suitable for use during both development and manufacturing.
Review, improve, and support the formal release of test software updates in response to: Changes to product or test specifications Changes to software and/or algorithm requirements Bug fixes Deployment of test solutions to new sites Test-time reduction initiatives
Analyse measurement data to verify test quality and assist with troubleshooting and root-cause investigations.
Work with engineering, verification, and manufacturing colleagues during new product development and the transition into production.
Create and maintain clear documentation for test software, algorithms, and related projects.
Participate in knowledge sharing with other team members on topics such as software development practices, library reuse, and optical component characteristics.

About You

An MSc or PhD in Software Engineering, Optoelectronics, Electronics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline Up to five years [NR1] of relevant professional experience.
Knowledge of object-oriented programming, ideally using C#, C++, or Java.
Experience with test systems, scientific equipment, or similar technical or lab/production environments.
Experience with Python or MATLAB.
Experience with data analysis, modelling, simulation, algorithm development, or measurement processing would be an advantage.
Experience or knowledge of semiconductor/optoelectronic devices, electronics, industrial automation, or manufacturing test environments [NR2] .
Comfortable collaborating with colleagues from different technical disciplines and sharing knowledge within a team.

Ensure adherence to company’s values (ICARE) in all aspects of your position:

I
ntegrity – Create an Environment of Trust

C
ollaboration – Innovate Through the Sharing of Ideas

A
ccountability – Own the Process and the Outcome

R
espect – Recognize the Value in Everyone

E
nthusiasm – Find a Sense of Purpose in Work

Application & Selection

Current employees who wish to apply should submit a cover letter detailing their interest in the position and how their skills and experience align with the requirements of the role.

If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the application process, please reach out to Alyxandra.Highland@coherent.com
. We are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds.

About Us

Coherent is a global leader in lasers, engineered materials and networking components. We are a vertically integrated manufacturing company that develops innovative products for diversified applications in the industrial, optical communications, military, life sciences, semiconductor equipment, and consumer markets. Coherent provides a comprehensive career development platform within an environment that challenges employees to perform at their best, while rewarding excellence and hard-work through a competitive compensation program. It's an exciting opportunity to work for a company that offers stability, longevity and growth. Come Join Us!

Note to recruiters and employment agencies:
We will not pay for unsolicited resumes from recruiters and employment agencies unless we have a signed agreement and have required assistance, in writing, for a specific opening.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer - Survey & Design
jobs.description:
10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that.

With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time.

Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034.

About The Role

As a Full-Stack Engineer in our Survey & Design team, you'll help build the products that support some of the most important steps in Aira's customer acquisition journey.

The team is responsible for the tools used to capture and manage information about our customers' homes, supporting everything from home surveys and technical assessments to installation design. These products help ensure that the right information is available throughout the process, enabling tailored and efficient clean energy solutions.

You'll join a small, autonomous product team and work closely with product managers, designers and engineers to solve real-world challenges and build scalable solutions that support Aira's continued growth across Europe.

As a Full-Stack Engineer, you'll play a key role in shaping the products and services that power these workflows. You'll work across the stack to build scalable solutions and great user experiences.

In this role, you will

Design and build applications and services that support users across multiple European markets
Develop scalable APIs and integrations with third-party systems
Process and manage data collected throughout the Survey & Design journey
Transform complex technical and geometric data into solutions that support our products and workflows
Contribute to architectural decisions and the long-term evolution of the platform
Collaborate closely with product managers, designers and end users to improve workflows, user experiences and product capabilities
Explore new technologies and approaches that help solve real business problems

We're making home energy design smarter, simpler and more scalable. If you enjoy building great products and solving complex problems in a technically challenging domain, this role is for you.

What You'll Bring To The Team

Around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer
Experience building modern software applications across different parts of the stack
Strong experience with Java and Spring Boot
Experience designing and building APIs
A solid understanding of databases, software architecture and distributed systems
Experience working with microservices
The ability to turn ideas into clean, testable and scalable software
A proactive mindset and willingness to take ownership
Strong collaboration and communication skills

We believe you'll thrive in this role if you're curious, analytical and enjoy understanding the real-world challenges behind the software you build. You don't need a background in engineering, but an interest in technical domains and complex problem-solving will help you succeed.

We're also looking for someone who enjoys learning new technologies and is curious about how emerging technologies, including AI, can create value for both products and ways of working.

Our tech stack:

Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka, gRPC, Kotlin, Python, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Kubernetes and Docker.

What is in it for you?

Join a mission-driven company accelerating the transition to clean energy across Europe
Work on products that have a direct impact on how clean energy solutions are designed and delivered
Be part of a small, highly autonomous team with significant influence on product and technical decisions
Collaborate with talented colleagues across product, engineering and operations
Grow professionally in a fast-moving and international environment
Enjoy our brand-new office at Norra Stationsgatan 93 in Stockholm. Conveniently located near public transport, with Sankt Eriksplan and Odenplan stations just a few minutes walk away.

At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, enhancing our ability to serve customers and communities effectively. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join our team. Our commitment is to uphold equality and inclusivity, fostering a collaborative environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to a better future for our people and the planet.
